Everything for the review screen: company, founders, score breakdown with cited

The DD view for the current round: checklist, claims, verifications, mail thread,

post.description:
Start due diligence (or a second request round, max 2): the candidate moves to
`in_dd`, Scout lists the missing items and drafts the request email
(`stage: request_drafted`).

Upload a document for a candidate (`multipart/form-data` with `file` and `kind`).
Parsing and claim extraction run in the background (`run_id`). Uploading the same
file twice returns the existing document.

413.description: File is over the size cap

post.description:
Generate (or regenerate) the investment memo. When the run is `done`,
`GET /candidates/{id}` has `latest_memo_id`.
Draft a message to the founders (status `draft`). Nothing is sent yet.
Fetch fresh data now ("re-check now"), then re-score. Spends credits.
Re-score from the facts and claims already collected (no new data, no credits).

Move the candidate. Allowed: `new → shortlist | watch | pass`,
`shortlist → watch | pass`, `in_dd → invest | watch | pass`, `watch → shortlist | pass`,
`pass → watch`. `in_dd` is entered with `POST /candidates/{id}/dd`, not here.
Anything else is 409 `not_allowed`. `invest` starts memo generation; `watch` and
`pass` start a Crustdata watch.
Approve the request email draft (edit it first with `PUT /outreach/{id}`).

The partner sent the request by hand (no Gmail): `stage → awaiting_founder`.
Upload the founder's files with `POST /candidates/{id}/documents`.
Send the approved request through Gmail: `stage → awaiting_founder`. Idempotent.

The memo as markdown with `[n]` citation markers, the citations, and sentences the

put.description:
Edit a message (also the DD request draft). Editing an `approved` message sends it
back to `draft`, so the changed text must be approved again. 409 once sent.

post.description: The partner approves the text: `draft → approved`. Required before sending.
The partner sent it by hand (copied text, LinkedIn): `approved → sent`.

Send an `approved` email through the partner's Gmail: `approved → sending → sent`.
Safe to retry (idempotent). Needs Gmail connected; otherwise use `mark-sent`.

get.description:
Status, steps, credits spent, hold reason and the last 50 ledger rows. Poll this
if SSE isn't available; stop when `status` is `done`, `failed` or `held`.

Live progress as Server-Sent Events. Events:

- `step`: `{name, status, seq}` when a step changes (`StepEvent`)
- `run`: `{status, credits_spent}` when the run changes (`RunEvent`)
- `end`: `{}` once the run is `done`, `failed` or `held`; then close and
  `GET /runs/{id}` for the final state.

`EventSource` can't send headers, so use a fetch-based SSE reader with
`X-Investor-Id`.
The scoring profile, with `derivation` explaining each change from the generic one.

put.description:
Save edits. Creates a **new version with a new id** (`origin: edited`, status
`draft`). Weights must sum to 1 (422 otherwise).

post.description: Mark this version `confirmed`. Confirming a new version re-scores open candidates.
